# ANPR marocain v2 — E3.1 préparation des sources de localisation

Ce notebook télécharge **CCPD2019 depuis le lien officiel des auteurs**, puis crée un sous-ensemble déterministe destiné uniquement à localiser la plaque sur une photo complète. Le champ de transcription chinoise n'est jamais décodé ni utilisé. Open Images reste désactivé jusqu'à la revue de licence de chaque image. Aucun holdout marocain, aucun OCR et aucun entraînement de modèle ne sont ouverts ici.

#@title 1. Monter Drive et geler le run de préparation
from google.colab import drive
drive.mount('/content/drive')

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tarfile

def sha256_file(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as handle:
        while chunk := handle.read(1024 * 1024):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()

SEED = 20260825 #@param {type:'integer'}
MAXIMUM_PER_CCPD_PARTITION = 1024 #@param {type:'integer'}
MAXIMUM_DHASH_DISTANCE = 4 #@param {type:'integer'}
RUN_ID = 'anpr_v2_e31_detection_sources_seed20260825_run01' #@param {type:'string'}
RENTFLEET_COMMIT = '21e1e243c9a4360445e691c8beae4daac696bd48'
CCPD_COMMIT = '02aaea15137c4d2fe662e57d257c6822356e9304'
CCPD_DRIVE_FILE_ID = '1rdEsCUcIUaYOVRkx5IMTRNA7PcGMmSgc'
assert SEED == 20260825 and MAXIMUM_PER_CCPD_PARTITION == 1024
assert MAXIMUM_DHASH_DISTANCE == 4
USER_OUTPUT_ROOT = Path('/content/drive/MyDrive/moroccan-anpr-e31-runs')
SAVED_OUTPUT = USER_OUTPUT_ROOT / RUN_ID
assert not SAVED_OUTPUT.exists(), f'Aucun écrasement autorisé: {SAVED_OUTPUT}'
print({'run_id': RUN_ID, 'task': 'plate_detection_source_preparation', 'final_test_opened': False, 'open_images_training_enabled': False})

#@title 2. Récupérer exactement le code E3.1 publié
REPO_DIR = Path('/content/rentfleet-e31')
assert not REPO_DIR.exists()
subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--filter=blob:none', '--no-checkout', 'https://github.com/getibplay-cmyk/pfe.git', str(REPO_DIR)], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'checkout', '--detach', RENTFLEET_COMMIT], cwd=REPO_DIR, check=True)
resolved = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO_DIR, text=True).strip()
assert resolved == RENTFLEET_COMMIT
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'py_compile', str(REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/vehicle_plate/detection_sources.py')], check=True)
print({'rentfleet_commit': resolved})

#@title 3. Vérifier le téléchargeur Google Drive préinstallé
import PIL, gdown
assert gdown.__version__ == '5.2.2', f'Version gdown inattendue: {gdown.__version__}'
print({'python': sys.version.split()[0], 'pillow': PIL.__version__, 'gdown': gdown.__version__})

#@title 4. Geler le dépôt officiel CCPD et sa licence MIT
CCPD_REPO = Path('/content/CCPD-source')
assert not CCPD_REPO.exists()
subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--filter=blob:none', 'https://github.com/detectRecog/CCPD.git', str(CCPD_REPO)], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'checkout', '--detach', CCPD_COMMIT], cwd=CCPD_REPO, check=True)
resolved_ccpd = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=CCPD_REPO, text=True).strip()
assert resolved_ccpd == CCPD_COMMIT
license_text = (CCPD_REPO / 'LICENSE').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert 'MIT License' in license_text and 'Copyright (c) 2017 CCPD' in license_text
print({'ccpd_commit': resolved_ccpd, 'license': 'MIT'})

#@title 5. Télécharger et extraire CCPD2019 depuis le lien officiel
CCPD_ARCHIVE = Path('/content/CCPD2019.tar.xz')
CCPD_EXTRACTED = Path('/content/ccpd-extracted')
assert not CCPD_ARCHIVE.exists() and not CCPD_EXTRACTED.exists()
downloaded = gdown.download(id=CCPD_DRIVE_FILE_ID, output=str(CCPD_ARCHIVE), quiet=False)
assert downloaded and CCPD_ARCHIVE.is_file()
assert CCPD_ARCHIVE.stat().st_size > 1_000_000_000, 'Archive CCPD anormalement petite'
archive_sha256 = sha256_file(CCPD_ARCHIVE)
CCPD_EXTRACTED.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(CCPD_ARCHIVE, mode='r:xz') as archive:
    archive.extractall(CCPD_EXTRACTED, filter='data')
image_count = sum(1 for path in CCPD_EXTRACTED.rglob('*') if path.suffix.lower() in {'.jpg', '.jpeg'})
assert image_count > 300000, f'Corpus CCPD incomplet: {image_count} images'
print({'archive_bytes': CCPD_ARCHIVE.stat().st_size, 'archive_sha256': archive_sha256, 'extracted_images': image_count})

#@title 6. Construire le bundle boîtes-only, dédoublonné et group-safe
LOCAL_BUNDLE = Path('/content/anpr-e31-ccpd-detection-bundle')
assert not LOCAL_BUNDLE.exists()
prepare_command = [
    sys.executable, '-m', 'scripts.intelligence.vehicle_plate.detection_sources',
    'ccpd', '--input-root', str(CCPD_EXTRACTED), '--output-dir', str(LOCAL_BUNDLE),
    '--license', str(CCPD_REPO / 'LICENSE'), '--seed', str(SEED),
    '--maximum-per-partition', str(MAXIMUM_PER_CCPD_PARTITION),
    '--maximum-dhash-distance', str(MAXIMUM_DHASH_DISTANCE),
]
subprocess.run(prepare_command, cwd=REPO_DIR, check=True)
source_report = json.loads((LOCAL_BUNDLE / 'generation_report.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert source_report['safeguards']['ccpd_sequence_field_parsed'] is False
assert source_report['safeguards']['ccpd_sequence_field_used_as_ocr_truth'] is False
assert source_report['safeguards']['contains_test_split'] is False
assert source_report['safeguards']['final_test_opened'] is False
assert set(source_report['artifacts']['split_counts']) == {'train', 'validation', 'calibration'}
print(source_report['artifacts'])

#@title 7. Sceller le bundle borné dans Drive privé
LOCAL_ARCHIVE = Path('/content/anpr-e31-ccpd-detection-bundle.tar')
assert not LOCAL_ARCHIVE.exists()
with tarfile.open(LOCAL_ARCHIVE, mode='w') as archive:
    archive.add(LOCAL_BUNDLE, arcname=LOCAL_BUNDLE.name)
bundle_archive_sha256 = sha256_file(LOCAL_ARCHIVE)
completion = {
    'schema_version': '1.0.0',
    'status': 'e31_detection_sources_prepared_not_qualified',
    'run_id': RUN_ID,
    'repository_sha': RENTFLEET_COMMIT,
    'ccpd_repository_sha': CCPD_COMMIT,
    'ccpd_original_archive_sha256': archive_sha256,
    'ccpd_bounded_bundle_archive_sha256': bundle_archive_sha256,
    'ccpd_bundle_report': source_report,
    'open_images_status': 'candidate_only_pending_per_image_license_review',
    'open_images_images_downloaded': 0,
    'qualification_claim': False,
    'final_test_opened': False,
    'model_trained': False,
    'saas_integration_allowed': False,
}
USER_OUTPUT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PARTIAL = USER_OUTPUT_ROOT / f'.partial-{RUN_ID}'
assert not PARTIAL.exists()
PARTIAL.mkdir()
shutil.copy2(LOCAL_ARCHIVE, PARTIAL / LOCAL_ARCHIVE.name)
(PARTIAL / 'E31_SOURCE_PREPARATION_COMPLETE.json').write_text(json.dumps(completion, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'freeze'], stdout=(PARTIAL / 'runtime-pip-freeze.txt').open('w', encoding='utf-8'), check=True)
artifact_names = ['anpr-e31-ccpd-detection-bundle.tar', 'E31_SOURCE_PREPARATION_COMPLETE.json', 'runtime-pip-freeze.txt']
hash_lines = []
for name in artifact_names:
    path = PARTIAL / name
    hash_lines.append(f'{sha256_file(path)}  {name}')
(PARTIAL / 'SHA256SUMS').write_text('\n'.join(hash_lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
PARTIAL.rename(SAVED_OUTPUT)
assert sha256_file(SAVED_OUTPUT / LOCAL_ARCHIVE.name) == bundle_archive_sha256
print({'saved_output': str(SAVED_OUTPUT), 'artifacts': artifact_names + ['SHA256SUMS'], 'final_test_opened': False, 'model_trained': False})

## Sortie attendue

Le run produit un bundle CCPD borné, dédoublonné et scellé pour le développement de la localisation. Il ne produit ni poids, ni métrique de qualification, ni transcription OCR. L'étape suivante devra mélanger ce bundle avec les sources marocaines de développement déjà consommées, puis comparer un challenger au détecteur incumbent sans rouvrir l'ancien holdout.
